HOMEOWNER’S NOTEBOOK

When the hot water stops

Useful observations can make the first call more productive.

Check the scope

Does it affect one outlet or the whole home? Is water cold, lukewarm, or inconsistent?

Keep the area safe

Avoid electrical components if there is water around equipment. Do not attempt unfamiliar gas, electrical, or pressure-related repairs. If you smell gas, leave and contact the appropriate emergency provider from a safe location.

Prepare for the call

Have model information and symptoms ready if safely accessible. Discuss repair versus replacement after assessment.
